x-lazada-request-parameters.name: status
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc:
1. planned: when stop is dispatched to courier
 2. arrived: when driver arrived at stop and start pickup
 3. finished: when driver finished pickup at the stop
 4. skipped: when driver selected to skip the stop due to some reason
 5. removed: when the stop has 0 RTS

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: statusUpdateTime
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: actual process time when reaching the status

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: eta
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: when the ETA is updated, need to update the data to Lazada side, scenario include:   1. without ETA  >> with ETA   2. with ETA >> without ETA   3. ETA change from A to B
